title: Personalized Gaming
author: Matt84594636
selftext:
Folks may have seen a new wc3 campaign was released. It doesn't have base building, which is an important part of the game if you ask me... so I was inspired to bring a new campaign to life for myself, that involved all the core mechanics of wc3, in the style of wc2. 

I think this kind of campaign, personalized to my tastes, could be an interesting future of gaming. I can imagine more and more robust map editors being released, ready for AI piloting, to build out whatever lore or scenarios a user puts into them! 

Here is a preview of what I have built so far, using Astra 6 to plan and build my coding harness and Fable 5.1/Sonnet 5 to write all the code.
